reviews.x: I saw cloths like these advertised somewhere else for considerably more. I figured I would give these a chance and see if they really worked. I was not disappointed! They are very soft and removed every bit of my eye make-up as well as foundation simply by wetting them. I did cleanse and moisturize after. I gave a couple for my daughters to try, so I'll probably be ordering another set soon.

replacing something I got for a gift and have loved.  so many different ones offered now.  tried to read lots reviews and decided on this one.  Great choice.  Shared extras with family. Soooo soft... and large.  my other one was about half this size.  Love the colors too. Great job manufacturer!

Great value for your money (pack of 6). The only complaint is that it does not glide on the skin as a makeup wipe does, as there is no oil on it. So it takes a little more work to remove stubborn makeup but it does in fact remove waterproof very well! Very great product that’s eco friendly!

These cloths are amazing! I was skeptical at first... how could a cloth with just water on it remove make up, including mascara and eyeshadow? To my surprise, they work extremely well. They do the same thing as the expensive name brand make up erasers. They wash very well and did not shrink even after being dried in a hot drier.  I recommend washing them with a regular load of laundry, rather than with towels. I tried washing them with towels and they picked up a lot of towel lint. So now I’m ba

reviews.t: Incredible product!!! Does what it's supposed to!!!
reviews.x: OMG! I really love these makeup removers! A friend of mine uses a makeup remover cloth and recommended to me. So when I saw these on Amazon I was like, "these are so inexpensive! 6 clothes for less than $20!" I had to try. I used just water and all my makeup, even my mascara came off. This isn't a "magic" makeup remover. I did have to go over and under my eyes to get rid of all my eye makeup  a few times. But these clothes are so soft they don't irritate the skin or the eye area.  I highly recom

reviews.t: takes the makeup off and soft
reviews.x: Follow the directions and it really does work!! I use it every night . I will still use a cleanser especially around the eyes I don’t want to rub my mascara off since I’m over 60 and not wanting to pull my skin. It’s long enough so I can use all sides top to bottom and it doesn’t smell as many people complain about other manufacturers. I liked it so much I gave one to a friend and she loves it and her husband is happy because she’s not wiping her face off on his expensive white towels!!!!

reviews.t: Soft,  reusable....and great for the environment!
reviews.x: After trying many disposable wipes I just couldn't find an affordable one for my sensitive skin. I can use my sensitive skin face wash along with these soft microfiber wipes and get the clean skin I'm looking for without the harshness of disposable wipes and without the redness they caused my skin to form. I can use one wash cloth twice then throw them in the laundry at the end of the week. Great for the environment compared to disposable wipes!

I love these they are so soft cute colors clean in the washer and come out brand new. I used them to remove make up and clean up after a work out big enough to used for a whole week if you wanted have to sides with two different feels so they are perfect for the face and other areas! GET THEM YOU NEED THEM.

My skin is so much happier. Until recently I didn't know I needed to remove my makeup before washing my face. I thought my cleanser was removing my makeup, but boy was I wrong. This takes off my makeup and then I’m able to successfully wash my face. My face has never been clearer. Buy it! You’re welcome!

I was pretty skeptical at first but just had to try them to see what all the hype was about.  I was shocked to say the least from them very first use. They truly take off ALL if my make up and come clean with very few stains after washing, even with no pretreat. I hate that I waited so long to purchase!

reviews.t: They’re great quality for a great price!
reviews.x: Love these little cloths, super soft, a bundle of 6 for a great price, and they do what promised.  I used them with just plain water- my makeup is not waterproof- and everything came out. I love having a clean face without having to use any remover products on my face. I really recommend these cloths.~

These are soft and do remove makeup with just water, but they are rougher on my skin than the original makeup remover cloths.  I felt like they pulled my skin when I tried to take off my eye makeup. I honestly have given them to my daughter to use when pretending to bathe her dolls.

I purchased this a few months ago and these have become part of my daily routine. I cannot believe how well they clean my face. I have used with face wash and without and either way they remove all the makeup from my face. They wash well and hold up wash after wash.

These are great!  I was skeptical about how well my eye makeup would come off with these, it is pretty stubborn to remove, yet it all came off with little effort.  I can remove my makeup fully without using makeup wipes and spend far less money in the process.

These are amazing! They are so soft on your face and remove makeup effortlessly! I have a few spots of eczema on my forehead which gets aggravated by rough washcloths, I highly recommend these cloths for everyone who cares about their skin! Enjoy! Valerie

I really do love these so much! The only thing I’ve found is that sometimes they shed a little bit, but obviously it comes right off when you splash your face with water! I haven’t had any crazy breakouts since switching to them. I highly recommend!

These work very well! I oil cleanse with Almond oil and coconut oil and this cloth helps get rid of it alllll. I do go over it with a makeup wipe but there’s (hardly) nothing left! Throw them in the washer and dryer and they’re still soft.

reviews.t: So good, I am buying more.
reviews.x: This is my second purchase of these make-up remover clothes.  They work so well, I purchased some for my teenage daughter and niece. So much easier, affordable, and effective than make-up remover fluids, lotions, and wipes.

These little towels are wonderful to remove all kinds of makeup. The warmer the water used is better. I use a bit of no more years baby wash or shampoo to clean the towel I use daily. Great price, great product!! :)

There is nothing to dislike about this product! It removes all my makeup easily with just water! I just toss them in the washer and the dryer! And they're ready to use again. Excellent product, excellent value.
Many of these "eraser cloths" suggest not to use any fabric softener.  I have found they last much longer if I indeed avoid fabric softener, and dry them by simply hanging them.  These are excellent.
Used them for make up removal. Very good, they wash and dry fast. They also arrived very fast. I have also purchased the more expensive one for $20.00 so to get 6 cloths I am very pleased.
Have not actually tried yet just want to encourage all girls to grab a remover like this! So enviro friendly to not be using disposable daily wipes along with saving tons of money!!
Exactly what I was wanting!  Stitched well around the edges; and my daughter at college loved the colors.  She uses these to remove heavy makeup without needing a lot of cleanser.
Amazing!!! So soft. Very nice and gentle on my sensitive skin. I'm amazed how something this affordable does the job of something expensive!! So glad I purchased this.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the cloths for removing makeup, including eye makeup and mascara, using just water.
Many reviewers describe the cloths as very soft on the skin.
Reviewers commonly highlight the good value and low price, especially for the pack of 6.
Several reviewers note the cloths wash well and hold up over repeated washing.
A few reviewers say the cloths are rougher on the skin or require more effort than expected, particularly for stubborn or eye makeup.
